items.html: And let us return to the matter, for indeed we have already explained how Ima nests in the Throne. And if so, since the light of the three highest illuminates in Beriah, certainly the light of Beriah is greater than the light of Yetzirah and Assiyah, and there is a great difference between them. And the matter is that indeed ZON have no complete coupling to give birth to souls, except by the Mochin given to them from Aba and Ima. Therefore, also the light of Beriah, upon which the light of the three highest shines, has the ability to have complete Mochin, in order to give birth to actual souls.
